title: String Concatenation
concept: Use + or string.str_concat to join strings together into a single larger string.
why: Building messages, creating output, and combining text are fundamental tasks in almost every program.
syntax_ref:
"hello" + " " + "world"  →  "hello world"
string.str_concat(a, b)   →  a followed by b
tips: `+` on strings joins them; `+` on numbers adds them
Use `" "` (a space string) to add spaces between words
You can chain `+`: `a + b + c + d`
common_mistakes: Trying to `+` a Str with an Int: `"Score: " + 100` needs format1 or conversion
Using `,` to join strings — that doesn't work in XIOM
